{{Quote|<small>STADIUM TEN: TAKE AIR TRANSIT GREEN.</small>|The text of a sign in Eusebus|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
'''Air Transit Green''' was a route in [[Eusebus]], a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. By leaving the city's [[Main boulevard of Eusebus|main boulevard]] and taking Air Transit Green, it was possible to reach [[Stadium Ten]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
